notes.title: Play as a girl with supernatural ghostly powers granted by a God of death!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37518397/b1ad47d4313dc18766d4d795e5d5c8ece729ede7.jpg[/img]

Hoo hoo, deadly little ghostlings! 
Dive into the story of a girl who has returned from the world of the dead with supernatural ghostly powers granted by a God of Death!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294340/Wonhon_A_Vengeful_Spirit/

[previewyoutube=1cFrtI5ndts;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a long and tough path, and without your support, we wouldn't have made it. As a result, we'd want to express our gratitude with a simple - [b]THANK YOU[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/fc11269959d5bc9e2150e6b8c22347be157bf4ad.png[/img]

A few words from Sean, the developer of [b]Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit[/b], who alone managed to create something that many people could not do with the team:

[i]“It’s been roughly over 2.5 years since I started developing this game - From December 13th 2018 to July 15th 2021! Developing Wonhon by myself has been a very challenging yet rewarding experience, pushing me to learn all sorts of things about 3D modeling, animation, level design, programming, and many other components that go into creating a game.


Nearly 1000 days of development! I can probably count on one hand the days I took off during all this time, so it really has consumed my life. I remember, the first day of development was entirely spent on creating a low poly version of one of the buildings used in the game. It took some time to figure out, but it looked pretty good by the end of the day. Before starting to develop this game, I didn’t know much about 3d modeling, so just discovering that I could make a low poly approximation of a traditional Korean house in Blender got me excited enough to think I could do this all by myself.
Wonhon was truly a labor of love for me, and I hope that players will feel it as they go through the game. I should also thank Gabsung Lim for the sound design, Alex Park for the story and dialogue in the game, and everyone at Super.com for their support. It wouldn’t have been possible to bring this game to life without their assistance and encouragement. 

If there are any rough spots in the game, please leave your feedback and I’ll do my best to polish it up even after the game is out. I’m excited to send this game out into the world now. Please enjoy the game!”[/i] (с) Sean, [b]Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit[/b] developer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/fc11269959d5bc9e2150e6b8c22347be157bf4ad.png[/img]


We sincerely hope that our efforts will pay off, and you guys fully enjoy the gameplay of [b]Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit[/b].
As always, we welcome any and all feedback, so please do let us know what you think about our game.

That’s it, fellow ghostlings. We’re monitoring incoming questions all day'n'night long with our fatigued, red eyes (and that, for once, isn’t a joke).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37518397/152fb1419df0940f7b1106ba900a0a3f6c12c315.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Free Prologue is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39892226/da8c7b1db3ad392e83db6b587c57e79b103721a8.png[/img]

Hello [b]Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit[/b] Community,

Today we are pleased to announce that we have made our prologue permanently available to download and play.

We feel that this is an important step for everyone as this gives you the chance to try out our game and get a feel for what it is like.

Armed with this experience, you can then make a well-informed decision on whether [b]Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit[/b] is the game for you!

Naturally, we hope that you will enjoy the game.

As always, we welcome any and all feedback, so please do let us know what you think about our demo in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1557060/discussions/0/3106892150622488331/]thread[/url] over in the discussion sections.

Likewise, if you would like to know more about our game, please feel free to ask your questions directly in the comments or community hub. You can also follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/wonhonthegame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/wonhonthegame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/8Sama6w]Discord[/url] for daily content, or read more in-depth articles about the game over at our [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/wonhon-a-vengeful-spirit]IndieDB page[/url].
